data.long_meaning: The name Syam is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Syamala', which means 'God of Dawn'. In Hindu mythology, Syam is the name of the god Vishnu in his form as the sun god. He is also known as 'Ravi' and 'Surya'. Syam is a name that symbolizes new beginnings, hope, and the arrival of light in one's life. The name Syam carries the meaning “God of Dawn” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Syam usually hope their child will grow to embody god of dawn and live with faith, good character and purpose.
